# Impact audio sources

The WAVs in `assets/audio/impacts/` are edited from the high-quality preview audio published on each Freesound source page. Each page identifies the source as [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The edits trim to the useful event, apply a low-cut filter and short fades, adjust peak levels, and encode mono 48 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV for positional playback.

| Game asset | Original recording and creator | Source excerpt (seconds) | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `punch.wav` | [Realistic Various Body Hits, bspiller5](https://freesound.org/people/bspiller5/sounds/478155/) | 3.34–3.78 | Quick body impact |
| `kick.wav` | [PUNCH-BOXING-03.wav, newagesoup](https://freesound.org/people/newagesoup/sounds/348242/) | 0.00–0.36 | Lower kick impact from the creator's glove Foley and drum layer |
| `crash.wav` | [Car Crash (with Glass), magnuswaker](https://freesound.org/people/magnuswaker/sounds/592388/) | 0.025–2.15 | Staged metal-and-glass crash Foley with a debris tail |
| `runover.wav` | [BODY FALL - V HVY - DIRT, leonelmail](https://freesound.org/people/leonelmail/sounds/504626/) | 0.32–1.37 | Heavy body impact and surface scuff |
| `runover_bike.wav` | [Scrap metal dropping / crashing, SamsterBirdies](https://freesound.org/people/SamsterBirdies/sounds/587443/) | 0.015–1.25 | Metal clatter when striking a downed bike |
| `weapon.wav` | [Scrap metal dropping / crashing, SamsterBirdies](https://freesound.org/people/SamsterBirdies/sounds/587443/) | 4.72–5.20 | Short metallic strike |
| `land.wav` | [BodyFall.wav, 000600](https://freesound.org/people/000600/sounds/187136/) | 0.28–0.88 | Body landing Foley |
| `whiff.wav` | [Whoosh, qubodup](https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/60013/) | 0.015–0.405 | Recorded bamboo-stick pass |
| `footstep.wav` | [boot steps on concrete foley, fedsmoker](https://freesound.org/people/fedsmoker/sounds/208531/) | 6.31–6.66 | Single boot step on concrete |

## Road ambience and race cues

These CC0 Freesound previews were trimmed, gain-adjusted and converted to mono 24 kHz, 16-bit PCM. The game crossfades loop boundaries for wind and ambience.

| Game asset | Creator and source | Downloaded preview | Excerpt (seconds) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `siren.wav` | [egomassive](https://freesound.org/people/egomassive/sounds/536773/) | [HQ MP3](https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/536/536773_1415754-hq.mp3) | 0–0.92 |

| `horn.wav` | [danlucaz](https://freesound.org/people/danlucaz/sounds/517673/) | [HQ MP3](https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/517/517673_9996727-hq.mp3) | 0–1.45 |

| `city.wav` | [iscence](https://freesound.org/people/iscence/sounds/711026/) | [HQ MP3](https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/711/711026_664439-hq.mp3) | 4–16 |

| `farm.wav` | [billgrip](https://freesound.org/people/billgrip/sounds/490850/) | [HQ MP3](https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/490/490850_2147090-hq.mp3) | 4–16 |

The wind excerpt was subsequently filtered from 110 Hz to 2.6 kHz and attenuated by 10 dB.

The siren source credits MultiMax2121 for the original recording. Nitro uses the existing egomassive rev recording. The optional street voice uses the existing [75 cm³ motorcycle acceleration](https://bigsoundbank.com/75-cm3-motorcycle-acceleration-s0603.html) recordings by Joseph SARDIN.
